examples.trans: That is the future mayor of Sineozersk!
I grew up in a communal flat.

meanings.note: adds a reason or an obvious truth

examples.trans: I did tell you, you know!

вести.gloss: to lead, to conduct (вести себя = to behave)

meanings.en: to lead, to guide, to drive
вести себя: to behave, to conduct oneself
meanings.note: Вы как маленькая себя ведёте = You're behaving like a little girl

examples.trans: You're behaving like a little girl.

examples.text: А ты иди домой и делай уроки.
examples.trans: And you go home and do your homework.
A noisy fight broke out on the street.

examples.text: Ты должен драться за свою любовь.
examples.trans: You must fight for your love.

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it

examples.trans: There is such a profession — defending the motherland!

meanings.note: in an election or for a job

examples.trans: He is a candidate for mayor.
Finally someone is for the people!
He is the mayor of the town.
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

нельзя.gloss: it is not allowed; one can't

meanings.note: needs 'не' with the verb: никто не войдёт

examples.trans: I know the town like nobody else.

meanings.note: declines like a feminine noun in -а, but is masculine

meanings.en: to beat up, to batter, to bruise
meanings.note: short passive participle побит / побита / побито = beaten up

examples.text: А почему у меня тогда лицо побито?
examples.trans: Then why is my face beaten up?

подраться.gloss: to fight, have a brawl, scuffle

meanings.en: to engage in a physical fight or brawl

examples.trans: The men had a fierce fight in the courtyard.
The boys fought over the ball.

examples.text: На столе стоял полный стакан воды.
examples.trans: A full glass of water stood on the table.

meanings.note: по порядку = in order; всё в порядке = everything is fine

examples.trans: Now let's go through everything in order.

meanings.note: short form: ты прав = you're right

meanings.en: to stop, put an end to

examples.trans: Stop it! We will have the flat.
The wind is blowing hard outside.

meanings.note: comparative of скоро used as adverb or particle

examples.trans: Let's go quickly to the studio!

meanings.note: affectionate form of сын, often used as a form of address

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

meanings.note: на улице холодно = it's cold outside

examples.text: На Московской улице перевернули ящики с мусором.
examples.trans: On Moskovskaya Street someone tipped over the rubbish bins.

meanings.en: to calm down, to settle down

meanings.note: Ваша честь = courtroom address to a judge

examples.text: Ваша честь, у нас есть заявление.
examples.trans: Your Honour, we have a statement.
It is a matter of honour.
I'm sick of this communal flat.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
